label.text: Drug Interactions The renal effects of nephrotoxic compounds may be potentiated by carboplatin. A decrease in phenytoin serum levels has been observed with concurrent administration of carboplatin and phenytoin/fosphenytoin. This may lead to exacerbation of seizures.

sections.contraindications: CONTRAINDICATIONS Carboplatin Injection is contraindicated in patients with a history of severe allergic reactions to cisplatin or other platinum-containing compounds. Carboplatin Injection should not be employed in patients with severe bone marrow depression or significant bleeding.
sections.nursing_mothers: Nursing Mothers It is not known whether carboplatin is excreted in human milk. Because there is a possibility of toxicity in nursing infants secondary to carboplatin treatment of the mother, it is recommended that breast-feeding be discontinued if the mother is treated with carboplatin.
